changes_made: OAuth2HandlerService.redirectToIDPLoginPage(): added URL validation using new URL() constructor before assigning to window.location.href
Scheme check: only https:// URIs are allowed — any other scheme (http://, javascript:, data:, etc.) causes the redirect to be blocked with an error log
On validation failure: fireOnConnectError is called with the error, sessionStorage['oidc_state'] is cleaned up, and no navigation occurs

files_modified.changes: redirectToIDPLoginPage(): added try/catch block around res.redirectUri with new URL() parsing and parsed.protocol !== 'https:' check. Blocked URIs log an error and call fireOnConnectError instead of navigating.

defense_in_depth.primary_control: URL scheme enforcement: only https:// redirect URIs from ApplinX server are accepted. Malformed URLs, http://, javascript:, data: and any other scheme are rejected. Uses the WHATWG URL API for robust parsing.
secondary_controls: Recommend: maintain a configured allowlist of valid IdP hostnames in sessionConfig.json and verify parsed.hostname matches
VULN-003 fix (same file): OIDC state parameter prevents CSRF even if redirect is valid
detection: Blocked redirect URIs logged as error: 'Blocked unsafe redirectUri from ApplinX server: <uri>'
response: On validation failure, user sees a connection error — no redirect to malicious site
